issues.title: Phase 8.1: crypto hourly trend-signal validation against buy-and-hold
issues.body:
## Summary
Add a research-first crypto hourly signal lab that tests explicit influencer-style indicator claims against `buy_hold` before any paper execution is allowed.

## Scope
- target `BTC-USD` hourly bars first
- keep the feature paper-disabled by default
- compare indicator-stack results against `buy_hold` after costs, drawdown, turnover, and benchmark-relative metrics
- preserve existing daily ETF and Phase 7 paper contracts

## Non-goals
- no live-money execution
- no Alpaca paper crypto execution
- no subjective chart-pattern labeling
- no social-media scraping in the first slice

issues.title: Add hourly crypto panel and annualized metric foundations
issues.body:
## Scope
- accept `1h` OHLCV inputs with `Date`, `Datetime`, or `timestamp` columns
- normalize timezone-aware hourly timestamps to UTC-naive panel timestamps
- add configurable `evaluation.periods_per_year`
- keep daily configs on the existing `252` default

## Depends on
- Phase 8.1: crypto hourly trend-signal validation against buy-and-hold

- financial-expert

issues.title: Add bar-based signal timing for intraday research
issues.body:
## Scope
- support `portfolio.ranking.rebalance_frequency: bar`
- define signal at the completed bar close
- execute on the next available bar open
- add no-look-ahead tests over 24/7 hourly calendars

## Depends on
- Add hourly crypto panel and annualized metric foundations

issues.title: Phase 8.6: crypto time-series ML strategy comparison
issues.body:
## Summary
Add a direct BTC hourly time-series ML research lane that compares long/cash ML thresholds against `buy_hold` and the existing Phase 8 pattern/meta baselines.

## Scope
- add opt-in trailing crypto time-series features
- add `configs/experiment.crypto_ts_ml_2024_ytd.yaml`
- persist `ml_strategy_threshold_sweep.csv`
- keep the acceptance gate strict: positive net excess return after costs, at least five exposure changes, and average exposure below `0.995`

## Non-goals
- no crypto paper trading
- no live-money execution
- no production promotion from a single research run

## Review
- financial-expert
- qa

issues.title: Phase 8.7: indicator-stack ML time-series tuning
issues.body:
## Summary
Add a BTC hourly research-only tuning lane that feeds deterministic indicator-stack features into the direct time-series ML strategy and selects model/threshold candidates on validation data before outer test scoring.

## Scope
- add opt-in indicator-stack ML features sourced from the existing indicator stack parameters
- add 6h, 12h, and 24h BTC hourly tuning configs
- persist `ml_strategy_tuning_candidates.csv` and `ml_strategy_tuning_selections.csv`
- report the selected long/cash strategy as `ml_indicator_tuned__long_only__cash`
- keep the gate strict: positive net excess return after costs, either Sharpe-like or drawdown improvement, and nontrivial exposure activity

## Non-goals
- no crypto paper trading
- no live-money execution
- no new ML dependency or deep time-series model family
- no ETH or multi-asset generalization in this slice

## Review
- financial-expert
- qa
